Since the enzyme Kesserol inhibits (HTX-2C) is not the enzyme Orbozide requires (HTX-1A), there is no mechanism by which Kesserol would reduce Orbozide's activation or alter its exposure. No other shared pharmacokinetic pathway (protein binding displacement, renal handling, etc.) is indicated by the provided data. Therefore, based on the information given, no clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction is expected.
